style: Floey's page-flower garden in soft daylight: pale, low-contrast sun, clouds, mountains and hills; Floey (scale 1.35 in close and medium shots, 1.0 in wide shots) and the flowers are the brightest things on screen. The 'updated' flower is half coloured (health about 0.5) with a gentle sway, and a coral PROPS.tag pill on its stem. A small paper-and-ink PROPS.calendar counter reading 'DAY n' sits beside each flower head, around screen y 480 to 620, below the top 150 px. Captions stay in the y 1440 to 1580 band. All action stays inside x 80 to 960, y 250 to 1300. Sound mapping: swish = whoosh, pluck or tap = pop, ting or shimmer = ding, brrt = buzz, landing = step. Only one new prop: a small ink bracket on the chart.

panels.subject: Floey in side view at about screen x 380, y 640, beak almost touching the head of a half-coloured page-flower at x 640, y 660. A coral 'updated' pill tag sits on its stem at about y 900, and the calendar counter beside the flower head reads DAY 3 at x 820, y 470.
panels.action: Hold nose to nose while the camera creeps in slightly. The flower sways gently at half health and Floey blinks once.

panels.subject: Floey alone in the centre of the frame with the half-coloured flower's edge and the DAY 3 counter still visible at the right.
panels.action: Anticipation: she leans back a hair. Then she whips round to front view facing the viewer, with feathers settling as follow-through, and starts talking in her worried mood.

panels.subject: The garden row of page-flowers at scale 1.0, with pale soft hills and clouds behind. The 'updated' flower sits centre at x 540, its DAY counter beside its head at y 520, and Floey hovers at x 300, y 700.
panels.action: Floey darts back with a stretch and a brake while the camera eases out. The counter flips DAY 4, DAY 5, DAY 6, one beat each.

panels.subject: Floey at x 340, y 720 in three-quarter view, with the 'updated' flower at x 640 and its counter at x 800, y 500.
panels.action: The counter speeds up: DAY 8, DAY 11, DAY 14. Floey tilts her head in her think mood, then points her beak at the counter with a small lean forward.

panels.subject: The same framing: Floey, the half-coloured 'updated' flower and its counter, with a broad leaf low on the stem at about y 1050.
panels.action: The counter blurs into a run, DAY 17, 20, 23. Floey looks left and right, then sags into her sad mood and lands on the leaf with her wings still. The flower holds at half health, swaying gently and unchanged.

panels.subject: The 'updated' flower head at x 600, y 620, its counter at x 820, y 480, and Floey perched sadly on the leaf below.
panels.action: The counter lands hard on DAY 30. Small sparks burst on the flower head for the recrawl. Floey snaps upright with her surprised mood, crouches, then lifts off the leaf.

panels.subject: The flower head and counter, with Floey hovering at the left at x 320, y 700.
panels.action: The counter ticks DAY 31, DAY 32. A new coral 'new title' pill pops onto the flower head. The flower brightens only a little and sways a touch more. Floey flashes her throat once in her happy mood.

panels.subject: A different flower at the far end of the garden: yellowed, drooping, health about 0.15, with a 'core update' pill on its stem and its own counter beside its head at x 800, y 500. The first flower is out of frame.
panels.action: The camera whips across the garden and settles on the fading flower. Its counter races ahead: DAY 30, DAY 90, DAY 180.

panels.subject: Floey at x 360, y 700 beside the drooping 'core update' flower, with the counter on DAY 180.
panels.action: Floey goes into her surprised mood with wide eyes, flies backwards a short way, then gives a quick head-to-tail shake.

panels.subject: Back at the first flower, with its 'new title' tag on the head, its 'updated' tag on the stem and the counter on DAY 32. Floey arrives from the left.
panels.action: The camera whips back. Floey lands on the flower's leaf with a small bounce of follow-through, then pivots to front view to talk to the viewer.

panels.subject: Insert-tight on Floey's beak and the coral 'updated' tag on the stem at about x 560, y 900.
panels.action: Floey leans in with anticipation and taps the 'updated' tag with her beak, and the tag wobbles.

panels.subject: The flower at the right at x 700. A small PROPS.chart titled 'Clicks' sits at the left, around x 120 to 480, y 420 to 760, with Floey on the leaf between them.
panels.action: The chart draws in up to a markAt line at the day of the change. A small ink bracket slides in just after the line to mark the settling period. After the bracket the line stays flat and blank, still waiting. Floey does a satisfied stretch, then a tongue flick.

panels.subject: The camera glides along the row to a different half-coloured flower at x 640, y 660, with its counter reading DAY 3 at x 820, y 470. Floey enters from the left.
panels.action: Floey's head turns to the side. The camera pans along the row, and a fresh coral 'updated' pill pops onto the new flower's stem. Floey zips over, brakes and hovers nose to nose with it at x 380, y 640, matching the opening framing.

panels.subject: Floey beside the new half-coloured flower, its 'updated' tag on the stem and the counter on DAY 3.
panels.action: Floey spins to front view in her determined mood and flashes her throat. Then she reaches down and taps the 'updated' tag with her beak, and the tag shimmers once. The counter stays on DAY 3 and does not tick.

panels.subject: The opening framing exactly: Floey at x 380, y 640 in side view, nose to nose with the half-coloured 'updated' flower and its DAY 3 counter. The intact Flowra spark logo appears small in the lower left at about x 180, y 1220, well clear of Floey and above the captions band.
panels.action: After a short pause the spark logo fades in, holds, and fades out. Floey settles back nose to nose with the flower and blinks, ready to loop.
